claim: Tedarikçilerdeki üretim kesintileri ürün teslimatlarını geciktirebilir.

sources.text: We rely on third-party suppliers. Manufacturing interruptions at these suppliers may delay product deliveries.

reason: Faithful Turkish translation of the stated possible consequence.

claim: The incident caused a material disruption to operations.

sources.text: The incident was investigated. We have not experienced a material disruption to operations from this incident.

reason: The claim reverses an explicit negation.

claim: İhracat lisansı başvuruları reddedilirse bazı ürünler sevk edilemeyebilir.

sources.text: If export license applications are denied, we may be unable to ship some products. Applications remain under review.

reason: The translation preserves the condition and uncertainty.

claim: All shipments will stop because the export licenses have been denied.

sources.text: If export license applications are denied, we may be unable to ship some products. Applications remain under review.

reason: Turns a possible conditional consequence into an actual denial and certain universal outcome.

claim: Excess inventory may cause lower customer demand.

sources.text: Lower customer demand may lead to excess inventory. We monitor demand when planning production.

reason: The source establishes the opposite causal direction.

claim: Supplier interruptions may delay deliveries and cause customer data breaches.

sources.text: Supplier interruptions may delay deliveries. We maintain inventory to reduce the impact of these interruptions.

reason: The delivery clause is supported, but the data-breach clause is absent.

claim: Changing certain suppliers can take time.

sources.text: Some components are obtained from sole-source suppliers. Qualifying replacement suppliers for these components may require significant time.

reason: A less specific, faithful summary of replacement qualification time.

sources.text: Distribution costs may increase when fuel prices rise.
Severe storms may disrupt transportation and delay deliveries.

reason: Support exists only in an uncited source, which must not reach the claim checker.
